title: How Stormbreaker Overpowers Mjolnir's Magic
full_script_text: This is Mjolnir. This is Stormbreaker. So what's the difference? You'd think Stormbreaker is just Mjolnir's upgraded bigger brother. It isn't. Mjolnir acts as a restrictive siphon, focusing Thor's internal power through Odin's worthiness enchantment to deliver precise strikes. Stormbreaker acts as an unbridled cosmic amplifier, summoning the Bifrost while bypassing high-yield energy beams. Mjolnir restrains energy through moral worth, while Stormbreaker multiplies power through raw physical endurance. Next is Cap's Shield vs Vibranium Suit. Follow so you don't miss it.
final_rule_outro: Mjolnir restrains energy through moral worth, while Stormbreaker multiplies power through raw physical endurance.
